task.title: How to Test and Use ClickUp Connector Features

user_message.content: Help me test the ClickUp connector and show me how to use its feature (e.g. show any data you fetched with it). Give me a brief about its capabilities.

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content: Understood. I’ll verify the ClickUp connection, retrieve a small set of read-only workspace data, and then summarize the connector’s capabilities with practical usage examples.

**The ClickUp connector passed the test.** It is enabled and successfully performed read-only workspace discovery, hierarchy retrieval, task search, and direct task lookup.

It found **3 accessible workspaces**. Representative fetched data included the spaces **Apartment Corp Workspace**, **Team Space**, **Vacancy Report Webapp**, and **PropertyMax.ai**. A task search returned examples such as **Collections** (completed), **Vacancy Report App** (Closed), and **Phone Excellence** (completed).

The connector currently supports **52 operations**, covering task management, search, comments, attachments, time tracking, folders/lists, workspace members, chat, reminders, custom fields, and ClickUp documents. I made no changes to your account.

I attached a concise report with the test evidence, capability table, and natural-language examples showing how to use the connector.
